item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"item_id":"youtube:O8rLfw06qOo","version_id":"3e84409215650079dca0ffdb95ebde4d86c1ad4145552f7e1dcb3f95c7855d9f","decision":"accept","reason":"This fresh, timestamped Autodesk case study is directly relevant to manufacturing design and CAM: at 00:01:34–00:01:39, Uni-Fab reports replacing a custom-fixture workflow with 3D toolpaths and two setups, reducing runtime from 3.5 hours to 45 minutes; at 00:02:00–00:02:04 it reports machine simulation across nine machines.
